text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwait says Iraq failed to comply with United Nations 1990-91 Gulf crisis resolutions dealing with prisoners of war.
- Kuwait Stock Exchange hits new record high on Saturday.
- Some 20 million shares of Burgan Bank to be sold by public auction on Monday.
- Rise in fuel prices caused a 14 percent increase in sea transport cost per container, economic expert says.
- Kuwait calls for U.N. to start reviewing compensation forms submitted by Kuwait on damages caused by the 1990-91 Iraqi occupation.

- Parliamentary delegation to visit prime minister to call for larger representation by MPs in a post-election cabinet. Kuwait held parliament election last week. By law at least one elected MP has to join the new government.
- Premier expected to present new government for emiri approval next week.
